command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== plink version (tag says 1.90b7.7; the binary self-reports) =="
# NEVER pipe into head under `set -o pipefail`: the writer gets SIGPIPE and aborts the script (exit 141)
plink --version > plinkver.txt 2>&1 || true
PVER=$(awk 'NR==1{print $2}' plinkver.txt)
echo "plink $PVER"

echo "== arm64 from inside: ELF e_machine must be 183 (AArch64) =="
EM=$(od -An -tu1 -j18 -N2 "$(command -v plink)" | awk '{print $1 + $2*256}')
echo "e_machine $EM"; test "$EM" -eq 183

echo "== synthetic cohort: 300 samples, 1000 SNPs, 2% missing, seed 42 =="
plink --dummy 300 1000 0.02 0 acgt --seed 42 --make-bed --out data >/dev/null
plink --bfile data --freq counts --seed 42 --out pcount >/dev/null
plink --bfile data --recode A --seed 42 --out raw >/dev/null

echo "== CHECK 1 (exact, integer): PLINK allele counts vs an independent hand count =="
awk 'NR==1{for(i=7;i<=NF;i++) nm[i]=$i; next}
     {for(i=7;i<=NF;i++) if($i!="NA") c[i]+=$i}
     END{for(i=7;i<=NF;i++) print nm[i], c[i]+0}' raw.raw | sort > handc.txt
awk 'NR>1{print $2"_"$3, $5}' pcount.frq.counts | sort > plinkc.txt
MISMATCH=$(join handc.txt plinkc.txt | awk '{if($2!=$3) b++} END{print b+0}')
NSNP=$(wc -l < plinkc.txt | tr -d " ")
echo "allele_count_mismatches $MISMATCH of $NSNP"

echo "== CHECK 2 (constructed truth): plant a causal SNP, require it to rank first =="
CAUSAL=snp500
awk -v c="$CAUSAL" 'NR==1{for(i=7;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ "^"c"_"){col=i}; next}
  {g=(col&&$col!="NA")?$col:1; srand(NR); print $1, $2, 10 + 3*g + (rand()-0.5)}' raw.raw > pheno.txt
plink --bfile data --pheno pheno.txt --assoc --allow-no-sex --seed 42 --out as >/dev/null
awk 'NR>1 && $9!="NA"{print $9, $2}' as.qassoc | sort -g > ranked.txt
TOP=$(awk 'NR==1{print $2}' ranked.txt)
TOPP=$(awk 'NR==1{print $1}' ranked.txt)
NEXTP=$(awk 'NR==2{print $1}' ranked.txt)

{
  echo "PLINK 1.9 -- allele-count identity and planted-association recovery"
  echo "plink_version         $PVER"
  echo "cohort                300 samples x 1000 SNPs, 2% missing, --seed 42"
  echo "allele_count_mismatch $MISMATCH of $NSNP   (assert 0 -- exact integer identity)"
  echo "planted_causal        $CAUSAL"
  echo "top_hit               $TOP   p=$TOPP"
  echo "runner_up_p           $NEXTP"
  echo "note  allele counts are integers, so this identity needs no tolerance; --freq (not counts) prints only 4 s.f. and would force a band"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$MISMATCH" -eq 0
test "$NSNP" -eq 1000
test "$TOP" = "$CAUSAL"
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
